diagFix.siteEmpty: No site address resolved, so texture links cannot be built. Set 站点地址 in the settings panel, or SKIN_BASE_URL.

diagFix.siteNeedsRestart: The saved site address is public, but this process still runs on the address it resolved at boot. Restart the service and texture links will switch over.
diagFix.siteLegacyBase: The address comes from the legacy base_url option, which outranks the environment variable: changing SKIN_BASE_URL does nothing. Fill in 站点地址 in the settings panel.

diagFix.migrationsPending: The database is behind the migrations this binary ships. Restart with SKIN_AUTO_MIGRATE on, or apply them with the migration CLI.
diagFix.mailNoSender: SMTP has a server but no sender address, so nothing is ever delivered. Fill in the sender address or the SMTP account.
diagFix.mailOff: SMTP is not configured: password resets and notification mails are not sent.
diagFix.previewNoProbe: No preview probe was injected at boot, so the render pipeline cannot be self-checked.
diagFix.previewNothing: The library has no public skin yet, so the probe had nothing to render. Upload one and this line becomes a real test.
diagFix.previewBroken: Rendering a real texture failed. Usually the database row exists but the file does not — a data volume that moved, or an import that skipped files.
diagFix.assetsNoDir: This process reported no web bundle directory.
diagFix.assetsMissing: The built index.html is missing, so every page except the server-rendered ones shows the placeholder. Ship web/dist next to the binary.
diagFix.keyringNoProbe: No signing-key status was injected at boot.
diagFix.keyringLocalOnly: No signing keys loaded: locally uploaded plugins still install, but official-market packages cannot be verified.
diagFix.keyringNoKeys: A plugin market is configured but no trusted signing key loaded, so installs and updates fail at verification. Inject the plugin trust keys.

help.title: Help
help.lead: The things players get stuck on, in the order that matters: get in, get wearing, get seen in game.
help.notShownTitle: Skin not showing in game — check these in order
help.notShownLead: The first two cover almost every case. Each one says whether the fix is on your side or on the server.
help.notShownLauncher: The launcher must connect through external login, not treat this account as a paid account
help.notShownLauncherBody: In HMCL / PCL2 choose external login and paste this site as the server URL. Signing in with a Microsoft account never asks this site for the skin.
help.notShownName: The name you join with must be one of your profiles
help.notShownNameBody: A skin applies to a profile created on the profiles page. Joining under another name is a different character and shows the default look.
help.notShownServer: The server has to accept this site identity
help.notShownServerBody: A server with online-mode=true and no external-login support will refuse this account outright, so the skin never gets a chance. That part belongs to the server admin.
help.notShownDomain: Texture URLs must be reachable from your machine
help.notShownDomainBody: Skins are served from this site address. If it is set to a LAN IP, has an untrusted certificate, or the domain is blocked, the client falls back to the default look — the site address is set in the admin panel.
help.notShownVerify: This site requires a verified email
help.notShownVerifyBody: With it on, an account whose address is not verified cannot sign in through a launcher — the website itself still works. Fill in the address on the profile page and send the verification mail; the link arrives by email, not from this page.
help.notShownPrivateBody: A private texture is visible only to you and to the site admins: its detail page, preview image and avatar link all refuse anonymous visitors. To let other players see it, make it public in the skin library, or wear a public texture instead.
help.launcherBody: The dashboard card "quick launcher setup" shows this site external-login URL — copy it, or drag the button onto the launcher window. HMCL: Settings → external login → paste as the server URL. PCL2 / PCL: login screen → external login → add server and paste. Then sign in with a name from the profiles page.
help.uploadSizes: Skins 64×64 or 64×32; capes 64×32 or 22×17 — both accept evenly scaled HD versions.
help.uploadSize: One file may not exceed {size}; anything larger is refused with the reason.
help.uploadName: The texture name you type at upload is what everyone sees; the closet alias is only your own label.
help.closetTitle: The closet is everything you can wear
help.closetBody: Uploads land in your closet automatically, and ♥ in the skin library collects somebody else work into it. Only closet entries can be worn: removing one stops it being wearable but never deletes the texture.
help.nameBody: Nickname: 2–24 characters — letters, digits, underscore or Chinese — used to sign in and displayed here. Profile name: by default 3–16 letters, digits or underscore (admins can widen it), and it is the name you show in game. Renaming never changes the UUID and does not revoke existing grants.
help.passwordBody: "Forgot password" on the sign-in card sends a reset mail (the site needs a configured mail service) and the link works for half an hour. Changing a password invalidates every launcher grant, so the next start needs a fresh login. If mail never arrives, check spam, then ask the site admin.

site_url.desc: Site address (absolute http(s) URL) — the shared base for page links, the sitemap, and texture/preview/avatar URLs; applies on restart. The OIDC issuer comes only from SKIN_OIDC_ISSUER / SKIN_BASE_URL, not from this field.

invite_required.desc: Require an invite code to register (applies immediately)

require_verification.desc: Require email verification before joining a server (applies immediately; new accounts then receive a verification mail automatically — pair it with the grace period below)

email_verify_grace_days.desc: Email-verification grace period in days: for N days after signup an unverified account still passes, 0 = enforce at once (applies immediately)

regs_per_ip.desc: Maximum accounts per IP address (0 = unlimited, applies immediately)

smtp_host.desc: SMTP server (empty = mail disabled; smtp_user or smtp_from must also be set as the sender, or mail counts as unconfigured; applies immediately)

smtp_port.desc: SMTP port (465 = implicit TLS; any other port upgrades with STARTTLS when offered; default 465)

smtp_user.desc: SMTP username (most providers expect the full email address)

smtp_pass.desc: SMTP password or app token (QQ and 163 want an app token, not the login password); never echoed back, and empty keeps the stored value

smtp_from.desc: Sender address (empty = use smtp_user; accepts the Name <a{'@'}b.c> form)

rate_limit_auth.desc: Auth-endpoint requests per IP per 10 minutes (0 = off; applies on restart)

login_fail_limit.desc: Consecutive failures that lock an account (0 = off; applies on restart)

cdn_enabled.desc: CDN mode: read the real client IP from the header order below. Enable only when Nginx or your CDN overwrites those headers (applies immediately)

cdn_headers.desc: Real-client-IP headers, tried in order, comma-separated (default CF-Connecting-IP, True-Client-IP, Ali-CDN-Real-IP, X-Real-IP, X-Forwarded-For)

access_detail_retention_days.desc: Days the diagnostic window keeps access-log detail rows (default 90); the sweeper deletes older access_log_details rows (applies immediately)

skin_domains.desc: Skin domains (CSV) allowed as texture sources in yggdrasil metadata

ygg_token_expire_1.desc: yggdrasil soft token window in seconds (default 259200 = 3 days): how long validate/join accepts a token; after it, refresh still works

ygg_token_expire_2.desc: yggdrasil hard token window in seconds (default 604800 = 7 days): how long refresh is accepted; after it the launcher must log in again

ygg_tokens_limit.desc: yggdrasil tokens per user (default 10, 0 = unlimited): over the limit the oldest are invalidated and audited

ygg_rate_limit.desc: Minimum interval in milliseconds between authentications of the same name (default 1000, 0 = off)

ygg_mojang_fallback.desc: Mojang fallback: query the official service when profile/hasJoined misses locally (on by default, applies immediately)

max_upload_file_size.desc: Texture upload size cap in KB (never above the server’s hard limit; applies immediately)

player_name_rule.desc: Player-name rule: official / cjk / utf8 / custom (guards new writes only, applies immediately)

custom_player_name_regexp.desc: Custom player-name regexp (used when the rule is custom)

texture_name_regexp.desc: Texture-note naming regexp (empty = unlimited; guards uploads and renames alike)

union_enabled.desc: Union module switch (hot toggle: off means every union route answers 404 and signing falls back to the local key)

union_api_root.desc: Union hub API root (default https://skin.mualliance.ltd/api/union, applies immediately)

union_member_key.desc: Union member key issued by the hub; never echoed back, empty keeps the stored value, applies immediately

union_enable_update.desc: Allow the hub to rotate the member key remotely (updatebackendkey; applies on restart)

union_enable_oauth2.desc: Union OAuth2 federated login (applies on restart)

union_queryemail_mode.desc: Union email query mode: full / off (applies on restart)

union_resolve_names.desc: Read each member site's name from its own discovery endpoint, in the background and through the guarded outbound client (the hub stores no names; off also hides names already read)

union_oauth2_sig_private_key.desc: Private key that signs Union OAuth2 user info (PEM; never echoed back, empty keeps the stored value, generated on first boot, applies on restart)

union_oauth2_sig_public_key.desc: Public key that verifies Union OAuth2 user info (PEM; generated on first boot when empty, applies on restart)
